name: Deep Research (u14app)
description: Browser-based deep-research app that generates in-depth reports quickly, also usable as an SSE API or MCP server.
whatItDoes: Produces a structured research report from a topic within a few minutes. It can be used as a web app, deployed for a team, or called by other AI services.
howItWorks: A Next.js app uses a thinking model to plan and a task model to carry out searches and write up findings. It can run with keys entered in the browser or with server-side keys protected by an access password. The same pipeline is exposed over an SSE API and an MCP server.

requirements.name: GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Gemini access on the server side

models: Gemini by default; other providers configurable
